question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
-- Top 3 customers by number of delivered orders, with avg payment value, city, state
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_customers c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
top3_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id
    FROM customer_order_counts
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_location AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_city AS city,
        customer_state AS state
    FROM olist_customers
    WHERE customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top3_customers)
),
customer_avg_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_customers c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON d.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top3_customers)
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT 
    coc.customer_unique_id,
    coc.delivered_order_count,
    ROUND(cap.avg_payment_value, 2) AS avg_payment_value,
    cl.city,
    cl.state
FROM customer_order_counts coc
JOIN top3_customers t3 ON coc.customer_unique_id = t3.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_location cl ON t3.customer_unique_id = cl.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_avg_payments cap ON t3.customer_unique_id = cap.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY coc.delivered_order_count DESC, coc.customer_unique_id
